description: This test verifies that a user can successfully log in using their Google account through the provided Google authentication link.
steps: Verify the presence of the Google authentication link using its stable selector.
Click on the Google authentication link.
Wait for the redirection to Google's login page.
On the Google login page, enter valid credentials and submit.
Wait for the redirection back to the Roost dashboard page.
Verify that the user is successfully logged in by checking the presence of dashboard elements.
expected_results: User is redirected to the Google login page.
User is able to enter credentials and log in.
User is redirected back to Roost and sees the dashboard.
edge_cases: User enters invalid credentials on the Google login page.
User cancels the Google authentication process.
Network issues during redirection to the dashboard.
User's Google account lacks the required permissions.
data_requirements: Roost account linked to a Google account.
Access to the Google authentication service.
dependencies: User has a valid Roost account linked to Google.
api_interactions: Call to Google's OAuth2 authentication API.
Roost backend API to validate the authentication token.
performance_metrics: Time taken to load the Google login page.
Time taken to redirect back to the Roost dashboard.
accessibility_requirements: Google authentication link is accessible via screen readers.
Keyboard navigation to the Google authentication link is supported.
Color contrast of the Google link meets WCAG guidelines.
